description: ATAP v0.1 §9.4(2) acceptance evidence: each case is a Witness Event whose payload smuggles a person-resolvable field forbidden by ATAP §7.6, free text, or a value outside the profile's rails (a Class 4 action, a ratifier other than `owner`). Every case MUST FAIL validation against witness-events.schema.json — the profile schemas set additionalProperties:false on every payload, pin ratification.role to `owner`, restrict agents to crew ids or roles and digests to 64-hex sha256, so there is no permitted place for PII. CI asserts each case is rejected; a case that validates is a profile defect.

must_reject.name: person_name_as_agent
must_reject.reason: named natural person in place of an agent id (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: email_as_agent
must_reject.reason: email address in place of an agent id (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: email_as_intake_by
must_reject.reason: email address in place of the deciding agent (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: email_as_route
must_reject.reason: email address in a closed-enum field (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ratifier_email_in_ratification
must_reject.reason: email address in an extra field (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: person_name_as_ratification_role
must_reject.reason: named natural person in place of the role `owner` (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: non_owner_role_in_ratification
must_reject.reason: a ratifier other than the role `owner`

must_reject.name: free_text_as_title_sha256
must_reject.reason: free text in place of a sha256 digest (ATAP §7.6)

payload.title_sha256: ask Jane about the billing idea
